metadata.document_title: Energy Mirror Sensor Requirements and Real-World Validation Specification
metadata.status: Engineering Specification & Software Analysis (Non-Energized / No Hardware Connected)

bulb_01.name: 12 W LED Bulb
bulb_01.load_character: Non-linear switch-mode LED driver with bridge rectifier; high harmonic distortion (THD_i)

fan_01.name: 45 W Ceiling Fan
fan_01.load_character: Single-phase permanent split capacitor (PSC) induction motor; slight inductive phase lag

pump_01.name: 75 W Water Pump
pump_01.load_character: Fractional-HP domestic booster pump; pronounced inductive phase displacement (Q ~ 60 VAR)

heater_01.name: 140 W Water Heater
heater_01.load_character: Purely resistive immersion heating element; unity power factor

active_power_w.target_accuracy: Class 1.0 (<= 1.0% of reading down to 20 W)
active_power_w.justification: Primary metric for all differential edge and energy tracking NILM algorithms

rms_voltage_v.justification: Essential for voltage sag compensation (P / V^2 normalization) to eliminate grid-induced drift

rms_current_a.justification: Required for apparent power calculation and overcurrent protection diagnostics

apparent_power_va.justification: Necessary denominator for power factor derivation (S = V_rms * I_rms)

power_factor.justification: Differentiates motor/inductive loads (pump PF 0.78) from resistive loads (heater PF 0.99)

synchronized_timestamp.justification: Enables strict 1-to-1 temporal alignment between mains telemetry and submeter ground truth

sensor_quality_indicators.justification: Prevents corrupted packets or ADC saturation spikes from creating false NILM transition events

signed_reactive_power_var.justification: Critical for disaggregating fractional pumps from SMPS electronics, but requires sign verification

line_frequency_hz.justification: Diagnostics for grid stability and synchronous timing verification

half_cycle_inrush_current.justification: Detects high-amplitude motor starting current transients (5x to 8x nominal)

harmonic_distortion_spectrum.justification: Required if 12 W LED bulbs are ever to be distinguished from background electronic noise

v_i_trajectory.justification: Lissajous curve feature extraction for complex multi-state non-linear load identification

high_frequency_waveform_sampling.mechanism: Continuous Sigma-Delta ADC sampling of instantaneous v(t) and i(t)
high_frequency_waveform_sampling.scope: Internal to metering IC or high-speed DSP; produces raw waveform points

per_cycle_electrical_metrology.mechanism: Cycle-synchronous numerical integration of v(t)*i(t) and RMS accumulators
per_cycle_electrical_metrology.scope: Internal DSP register updates; captures sub-cycle inrush transients

periodic_telemetry_snapshot.typical_rate: 1.0 s (prototype) or 6.0 s (standard Energy Mirror ingestion)
periodic_telemetry_snapshot.mechanism: Time-averaged RMS and power registers polled or streamed over UART/SPI/MQTT
periodic_telemetry_snapshot.scope: Transmitted payload received by edge gateway / backend; does NOT represent ADC rate

nilm_feature_window.typical_rate: 30 s to 60 s (5 to 10 consecutive 6-second samples)
nilm_feature_window.mechanism: Rolling lookback buffers computing Delta P, rolling std, rolling mean, and min/max
nilm_feature_window.scope: Software inference layer in backend or edge model for event extraction and filtering

ADE9153A.part_type: Single-Phase Energy Metering IC with mSure Autocalibration
ADE9153A.accuracy_spec: Class 1.0 / Class 2.0 active energy across dynamic range; typ 0.1% active energy error over 3000:1 dynamic range with mSure
ADE9153A.adc_architecture: Three independent 24-bit Sigma-Delta ADCs, 88 dB SNR
ADE9153A.update_rate: Half-cycle (10 ms) internal updates, 1.0s or programmable register streaming
ADE9153A.digital_interface: SPI (up to 10 MHz) with CRC-16 register protection
ADE9153A.isolation_and_safety: IC is referenced to mains hot/neutral shunt; REQUIRES external digital isolators (e.g., ADuM1401 / ISO7741) or isolated host MCU
ADE9153A.suitability_for_12w_detection: Metrologically capable of resolving < 1 W with low-value shunt (1 mOhm) and mSure drift correction, but cannot overcome mains voltage drift without software compensation
ADE9153A.approximate_cost_usd: IC alone: $4.50 - $7.00 USD; Evaluation Shield (EV-ADE9153ASHIELDZ): ~$80.00 USD (verified via Mouser/DigiKey)
ADE9153A.evidence_status: VERIFIED from official Analog Devices Rev 0 datasheet
important_unknowns: Phase calibration stability when using low-cost external split-core CT instead of direct shunt
Firmware complexity for non-standard mSure autocalibration sequences on ESP32 hosts

BL0942.accuracy_spec: < 0.1% active energy error across 4000:1 dynamic range; batch factory gain error < 1%
BL0942.adc_architecture: Two 24-bit Sigma-Delta ADCs with internal 1.218 V bandgap reference
BL0942.update_rate: Registers update internally every ~200 ms; max SPI clock 900 kHz
BL0942.digital_interface: Shared pin selectable UART (4800 to 38400 baud) or SPI (up to 900 kHz)
BL0942.isolation_and_safety: Non-isolated ground plane tied to mains line/neutral; REQUIRES optocouplers for USB/UART debug connection
BL0942.suitability_for_12w_detection: Current channel resolves down to 10 mA (~2.3 W at 230 V); suitable for 45 W and 75 W, marginal for 12 W in noisy environments
BL0942.approximate_cost_usd: IC alone: $0.60 - $1.20 USD (LCSC); Pre-assembled smart plugs with BL0942: ~$10.00 - $16.00 USD
BL0942.evidence_status: VERIFIED from official Shanghai Belling BL0942 datasheet (Rev 1.0)
important_unknowns: Exact sign and linearity of reactive power register under heavily distorted capacitive loads
Temperature coefficient of internal bandgap reference under high ambient temperatures (40 C+)

PZEM_004T_V3.part_type: Pre-Assembled AC Power/Energy Metering Module with Split-Core CT
PZEM_004T_V3.accuracy_spec: Headline +/- 0.5% for Voltage, Current, Power, Energy; +/- 1.0% for Power Factor
PZEM_004T_V3.update_rate: Internal register updates ~200 ms to 500 ms; polling faster than 200 ms yields cached duplicate values; recommended polling 1.0s to 2.0s
PZEM_004T_V3.digital_interface: Optocoupled TTL UART (9600 bps, 8N1) implementing Modbus-RTU subset
PZEM_004T_V3.isolation_and_safety: BUILT-IN optocoupler isolation between AC mains front-end and TTL UART pins; safe to interface directly to 3.3V/5V MCU or USB-UART converter
PZEM_004T_V3.suitability_for_12w_detection: POOR for 12 W. Current starting threshold is 0.02 A (~4.6 W); resolution is 0.1 W, but noise floor and phase error with 100A CT degrade incremental accuracy below 20 W
PZEM_004T_V3.approximate_cost_usd: $9.00 - $14.00 USD complete with 100A split-core CT (verified via authorized distributors)
PZEM_004T_V3.evidence_status: VERIFIED from Peacefair PZEM-004T V3.0 User Manual and Modbus specification
important_unknowns: Does NOT report reactive power (VAR) over Modbus; reactive power must be estimated without polarity
Split-core CT phase angle error at low currents (< 0.2 A) causes up to +/- 0.08 error in power factor

12w_led_bulb.mains_voltage_sag_sensitivity: A 1.0% grid voltage drop on an 800 W residential background load creates a 16.0 W apparent drop, completely burying the 12 W step
12w_led_bulb.current_transformer_floor: On a 100A CT, 12 W corresponds to ~52 mA RMS (0.052% of full-scale), operating in the non-linear magnetizing knee of low-cost iron cores
12w_led_bulb.detectability_verdict: NOT RELIABLY DISTINGUISHABLE from whole-house aggregate active power under realistic domestic noise floors without high-frequency harmonic metrology
12w_led_bulb.mitigation_in_software: Normalizing active power by instantaneous squared voltage (P / V^2) eliminates linear resistive drift, but does not cancel SMPS constant-power load fluctuations

45w_ceiling_fan.distractor_collision_risk: High overlap with 45 W - 65 W USB-C laptop chargers and 25 W - 50 W television backlight modulation
45w_ceiling_fan.detectability_verdict: CONDITIONALLY FEASIBLE in isolation, but VULNERABLE to concurrent switching and competing switch-mode electronic steps

75w_water_pump.reactive_power_separation: Inductive phase lag (Q ~ 60 VAR, PF ~ 0.78) provides strong physical separation from resistive heaters and SMPS supplies
75w_water_pump.detectability_verdict: FEASIBLE provided aggregate reactive power (Q) or accurate power factor is measured

aggregate_channel.sensor: Calibrated Mains Metering Front-End (e.g., ADE9153A with 1 mOhm shunt or Class 0.5 CT)
aggregate_channel.location: Service entrance panel / main distribution board breaker

submeter_reference_channels.sensor: Individual isolated inline submeters or calibrated smart plugs (e.g., BL0942 or PZEM-004T 10A model)

timestamp_synchronization.method: Local Network NTP Server with Millisecond Precision / Hardware Master Trigger
timestamp_synchronization.verification_procedure: Heartbeat synchronization ping logged every 60 seconds; reject records exceeding 200 ms skew

ground_truth_labeling_logic.derivation: Strictly derived from individual submeter reference channel active power; NEVER inferred from aggregate signal

hysteresis_rules.bulb_01: ON if P_sub >= 8.0 W for 3s; OFF if P_sub < 4.0 W for 3s
hysteresis_rules.fan_01: ON if P_sub >= 30.0 W for 3s; OFF if P_sub < 15.0 W for 3s
hysteresis_rules.pump_01: ON if P_sub >= 50.0 W for 3s; OFF if P_sub < 20.0 W for 3s
hysteresis_rules.heater_01: ON if P_sub >= 100.0 W for 3s; OFF if P_sub < 40.0 W for 3s

ground_truth_architecture.label_isolation_enforcement: Ground-truth states and reference powers are archived in separate SQLite/HDF5 tables and strictly excluded from the detector input feature matrix

experimental_phases.description: Zero-offset and gain calibration against laboratory reference multimeter (true RMS DMM) across 10 W to 2000 W loads
Single-appliance repeated ON/OFF cycles (20 trials each for 12 W bulb, 45 W fan, 75 W pump) with constant baseline load
Simultaneous switching trials where bulb, fan, and pump toggle within +/- 1 second of each other and background loads
Operation of 50 W laptop chargers, 25 W monitors, and cycling refrigerators alongside target appliances
Continuous 72-hour unconstrained domestic operation with strict train/val/test chronological partition

decision_framework.proceed_to_integration: Appliance achieves Event F1 >= 0.80 and FA/hr <= 1.0 across all phases including concurrent switching
decision_framework.repeat_calibration: Appliance achieves Event F1 between 0.50 and 0.80, with failures attributable to identifiable gain/offset errors
decision_framework.declare_fundamentally_infeasible: Appliance exhibits Event F1 < 0.50 or FA/hr > 3.0 due to noise floor submergence or distractor collisions

safety_and_compliance.mains_isolation_mandatory: All microcontrollers and host interfaces must utilize optocouplers or galvanic digital isolators rated for >= 2.5 kV RMS
safety_and_compliance.enclosure_spec: All live terminals enclosed in UL94-V0 flame-retardant, IP30 minimum non-conductive enclosures
safety_and_compliance.overcurrent_protection: Dedicated fast-acting fuse (e.g., 250 mA 250V ceramic fuse on voltage sensing inputs)
safety_and_compliance.personnel_qualification: Installation on electrical switchboards must be conducted exclusively by a licensed electrician under de-energized Lockout/Tagout (LOTO) protocols
safety_and_compliance.software_gate: ENABLE_HARDWARE_INGEST remains FALSE until all bench metrology acceptance gates are formally certified
